original_graph.physical_advance: unchanged PhysicalManeuverCircuit.drive/advance and original nominal substeps/tail
original_graph.cpu_quiet: 100 original .01s steps; exact registered CPU quiet hash before only3 private neutral buffers are installed

original_graph.new_history_first_observation: read original quiet state without calling advance(0)

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.window_semantics: Contiguous original observations [0:8],[8:16],... including short final window. Carry numerical neural state continuously; detach graph only at window boundaries. At row i>0 integrate previous original row command/body/mask/goals over the exact original dt[i]. Never use current or future input over past interval.
optimizer.empty_supervision_window: Integrate and retain every original state; detach at ordinary boundary; no optimizer step and no fabricated zero-gradient update.
optimizer.updates: Exactly one Adam step for each original contiguous window with >=1 eligible pedal cell; exact count sealed before fit. No extra epochs, tuning, retries, best-window selection or diagnostic fitting.
optimizer.parameter_evolution: Ordinary online TBPTT: earlier state retains values computed with earlier coefficients; no numerical rewrite after update. This is declared training semantics, not a fixed-parameter rollout.

loss.window_reduction: Per-axis eligible-cell mean, then mean over axes available in that window, exactly original helper
loss.metrics_reduction: Separate full-history per-axis sum/count using all original eligibility cells for baseline and final frozen-candidate rollouts
loss.fullbrake_one: Retain every otherwise qualified brake1 target and its loss, including stationary alias cases
loss.coactivation: Original states and targets retained; only both pedal loss cells masked by original loader/helper
loss.body: all21original channels and original masks retained; existing causal graph has angular2:5/speed16 paths, no claim of new load/tyre causal adaptation

same_history_gradient_qualification.separate_execution_stage: Exact new TRAIN/data/V4-loader/admission/source bindings sealed before model-only qualification. The resulting immutable certificate and original process terminal proof are additionally sealed into a new fit plan before optimizer construction or any step.
same_history_gradient_qualification.history: One original whole TRAIN history at initial coefficients, same8-observation detach boundaries and same loss masks
same_history_gradient_qualification.gradient_matrix: Each window with eligible cells contributes actual mean pedal-loss gradients for the two existing DNg parameters; all windows retained in declared order
same_history_gradient_qualification.required: finite actual gradients and rank2 over the complete window-gradient matrix under prospectively sealed SVD threshold; separate gas/brake counts and fullbrake1 losses reported
same_history_gradient_qualification.failure: No fit, no alternate rows/window/threshold, retain original loss/gradient evidence and resolve model/data limitation explicitly

rollouts: one final learned candidate whole TRAIN history
fixed_candidate_evaluation.each_rollout: One separately initialized original quiet state followed by continuous complete history under fixed coefficients; no internal reset
fixed_candidate_evaluation.heldout_geography: Separate new prospective heldout geography/conditions required later; TRAIN metrics are not generalization or driving qualification

resource_limits_to_reseal_with_trainer.cleanup: Record actual allocated/reserved/peak and clear owned references; process terminal is separate. Never infer measured zero/global GPU idle from process exit.

small_checkpoint: Two learned parameter scalars and exact original graph/readout/CPU-reference/source bindings; do not duplicate unchanged full checkpoint or original camera/event payloads
retained_full_goal: Fly compoundeye/motionvision and flight-derived balance/motor feedback in car virtualbody: steer/accel/brake/gears, tilt/rotation/load/tyre/setup adaptation, valid fast racingline and laptime.
